evidence: In the text, it is stated: 'Au(N(SiMe3)2)(PEt3) was applied with potential reducing agents and hydrogen sulphide. The best results in respect to growth rate and film properties were achieved when Au(N(SiMe3)2)(PEt3) and dimethylamine borane [BH3(NHMe2)] were applied alternately.' Additionally, 'Purging between the precursor pulses was done with nitrogen (AGA 99.999%).'
